strengths: A first-time viewer gets the primary message unmistakably and in order: the category in the first line ('end-to-end tests you never write'), one URL, explore → journeys → runs, Replay's browsers on a real 'Tue at 3:00 AM' schedule chip with six real Tuesdays, staging / preview / localhost, a real PR #3 runs table, 'recorded, then reviewed', and the end-card lock-up '{ End-to-end testing · fully managed }'.

The 67 ms bug is the film's best stretch and is fully concrete: Replay QA caught a performance bug in its own Projects page; 67 ms, four dropped frames shown as four hollow frame slots during a silence; no click; 25 of 27 renders changed nothing; the video-frame outline that keeps only the 2 renders that did change something; then a match cut to the real 'not memoized' Root Cause line. The 'Open' chip stays honest.
L0404's 'For what breaks, and what's slow.' is a clean bridge from functional e2e testing to the performance hook. It is grounded in the polish passes that filed both featured bugs.

L0601 'Every run, a recording. Every bug, a root cause. Every fix, rerun to confirm.' is the line to remember. It puts recordings, root cause and verification in eleven words, staged as a reading path over real product tiles.

Guardrails are respected throughout: 'about' and exact figures as the bible requires, Insights figures carry their 'Insights:' tag, 'every night' never appears near the weekly chip, there is no 'fixes your bugs' claim, the 258 never shares a frame with the Insights 258, and the agents are generic and unbranded.
